name: Task Status Cycler
description: Complete Pomodoros while carrying worked-on/deferred links, copying a closed named Pomodoro's name onto the created one, and copying each Task Link sub-bullet's sub-sub-bullets into the linked task's Work Log, toggle empty Pomodoro placeholders/sub-bullets with Ctrl+Alt+] including named placeholders, toggle Obsidian tasks with Ctrl+Shift+] — always prompting for promotion destinations when exact Tasks exists (Enter defaults to Tasks conversion, including in place when already there; typing creates a new section; non-Tasks stays plain; empty non-Tasks source sections are removed) and for demotions from Tasks — cycle Blocked tasks out with option+[/option+], recover affected Blocked dependents, propagate Ctrl+Enter to embedded task transclusions, and preserve embedded-task behavior. Ctrl+Enter on a Task Link closes the linked task and strikes the link, embedded or plain. A versioned `api.recoverBlockedDependents` lets other plugins recover Blocked dependents without retiring references; dependents with a strictly future `scheduled` date stay Blocked, and Ctrl+Enter on a Task Link to a Cancelled task shows a notice instead of completing the owning Pomodoro. Depends-On lines (managed ⛓️ **DEPENDS ON:** child bullets) are never struck, restored, reformatted, or tree-closed: Ctrl+Enter closes or reopens the linked prerequisite only, and Alt+[ / Alt+] cycle the link under the cursor.
author: Bryan
